entries.35dbe04b6296289f: A business that operates the direct recruiting service “MS Jobs.” Without consultants involved, job seekers can apply directly and employers can scout directly; it is based on the general career platform “MS Career” and can be used together with “MS Agent” under a single ID. entries.421ced614f6f8b51: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,034 million, an increase of 0.2% from the previous year.
entries.4d7ac22aa4959715: Founded in 1990 in Chuo-ku, Osaka, as Nihon MS Center Co., Ltd., and adopted its current trade name in 2011. Its head office is in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, and it is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of March 31, 2026, consolidated employees numbered 251, and it had two consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.5718df0c29530ecb: The company earns revenue from success fees on its placement service "MS Agent", direct-application "MS Jobs", advertising and lead provision for the media "Manegy", and placement and dispatch by its Australian subsidiary.
entries.68fe48f29c2050c8: In the revenue composition for the fiscal year ended March 2026, placement revenue of ¥4,294 million was the largest, followed by overseas placement revenue of ¥3,002 million, media revenue of ¥248 million, and DRM revenue of ¥101 million. By region, Japan was ¥4,644 million and Australia was ¥3,002 million.
entries.73743f03b5741c01: The company's basic policy is to use the databases and networks it has built up since its founding in the areas of professional service firms and corporate back-office departments, and to provide services that solve the problems of people in these areas, not only in human resources-related businesses. In human resources services, it is integrating its platforms into "MS Career" and working to make use of accumulated data and improve matching accuracy through AI technology; in media, it is promoting mutual linkage that directs the user base of "Manegy" to its human resources services.
